title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 180B — unsloth GGUF UD-IQ1_S (smallest usable)
slug_note: The 24GB-card lane for a 180B model: ~67GB in IQ1_S, runnable through llama.cpp. Vision arrives via a separate projector file. Vendor-claimed ~34.5 tok/s.

variation.quant_detail: UD-IQ1_S, unsloth's dynamic ~1-bit-per-weight scheme. Smallest usable Flash-Next build known.
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama.cpp with CPU/GPU layer split. Vision requires the separate mmproj projector file, which is not inside the main GGUF.

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 79.5 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Runs with partial GPU offload on a 24GB card — the rest spills to system RAM, which is where the throughput goes. Comfortable on 128GB unified memory.

steps.text: Download the GGUF plus its mmproj file

measurements.note: Vendor-claimed. No hardware or configuration stated in our source, so it is not comparable to any other row.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (670-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)

caveats: At ~1 bit per weight, quality degradation on a 180B MoE is not characterized anywhere in our sources. The vendor number is a throughput claim, not a quality claim.
The 34.5 tok/s figure has no stated hardware. Do not compare it to the Spark builds.
Exact repo id and quant filename should be re-verified against the publisher before download; our source records the org and quant name but not a confirmed repo path.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:UD-IQ1_S` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 70 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 79.5 GiB (weights + KV at llama.cpp's default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens on this build)).
